<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="it">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Beauty And Fashion · Parrucchiera a Varese (demo)</title>
<meta name="description" content="Beauty And Fashion, salone di parrucchiera a Varese: piega, taglio, colore e trattamenti con attenzione a una cliente alla volta.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@500;600&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#faf6ee;--bg2:#f1eadd;--taupe:#b9a898;--ink:#2a2724;--muted:#6b645c;--sage:#6f8a73;--sage-d:#4f6853;--card:#fffdf8;--line:#e2d9c8;
--serif:"Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;--sans:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#1d1b19;--bg2:#252320;--taupe:#8d7f72;--ink:#f3ede2;--muted:#bdb3a5;--sage:#93b098;--sage-d:#a9c4ad;--card:#2a2724;--line:#3b3733}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#1d1b19;--bg2:#252320;--taupe:#8d7f72;--ink:#f3ede2;--muted:#bdb3a5;--sage:#93b098;--sage-d:#a9c4ad;--card:#2a2724;--line:#3b3733}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:calc(72px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px))}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 17px/1.65 var(--sans)}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:600;line-height:1.1;margin:0}
a{color:inherit}
img,svg{max-width:100%}
.wrap{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 22px}
.demo{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);font-size:13px;text-align:center;padding:7px 12px}
header{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:10;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 92%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:68px}
.logo{font:600 24px var(--serif);text-decoration:none;letter-spacing:.01em}
nav ul{display:flex;gap:26px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
nav a{text-decoration:none;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted)}nav a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.menu{display:none;background:none;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 16px;font:500 14px var(--sans)}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:999px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;border:1.5px solid var(--sage-d);transition:.2s}
.btn.p{background:var(--sage-d);color:#fff}.btn.p:hover{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink)}
.btn.s{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink)}.btn.s:hover{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg)}
.eyebrow{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sage-d);font-weight:600}
section{padding:92px 0}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:48px;align-items:center;padding:64px 0 88px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(40px,6vw,72px);margin:14px 0 20px}
.hero p{color:var(--muted);max-width:30em;font-size:18px}
.cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:30px}
.art{aspect-ratio:4/5;border-radius:200px 200px 24px 24px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--taupe),var(--bg2) 60%,var(--sage));position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:grid;place-items:center}
.art svg{width:62%;opacity:.9}
.ph{position:absolute;bottom:14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:11px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);color:#fff;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap}
.alt{background:var(--bg2)}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}
h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4.4vw,52px);margin:10px 0 18px}
.lead{color:var(--muted)}
.pills{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.pills li{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px}
.pills b{display:block;font:600 22px var(--serif);margin-bottom:4px}
.pills span{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(290px,1fr));gap:20px;margin-top:36px}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:28px}
.card h3{font-size:28px}
.card .dur{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin:2px 0 14px}
.row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);font-size:16px}
.row b{font-weight:600;color:var(--sage-d);white-space:nowrap}
.note{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:26px}
.gal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:36px}
.tile{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:18px;display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;color:var(--ink)}
.tile:nth-child(1){background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d9cbb9,#f1eadd)}
.tile:nth-child(2){background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c5d1c3,#e8eee4)}
.tile:nth-child(3){background:linear-gradient(135deg,#b9a898,#e2d9c8)}
.tile:nth-child(4){background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e8eee4,#b8c8bb)}
.tile:nth-child(5){background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f1eadd,#cdbfae)}
.tile:nth-child(6){background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d3cbbd,#9fb3a2)}
.tile svg{width:34%;opacity:.55}
.tile span{position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;background:rgba(255,253,248,.85);color:#2a2724;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:99px}
.contact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;margin-top:36px}
.contact .card p{margin:6px 0}
.tel{font:600 32px var(--serif);text-decoration:none;display:inline-block;margin:6px 0 16px}
.hours{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:16px}
.hours td{padding:8px 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}.hours td:last-child{text-align:right}
.tbc{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:2px 10px;border-radius:99px;color:var(--muted);margin-left:6px;vertical-align:middle}
footer{background:var(--ink);color:#e9e2d6;padding:56px 0 40px;font-size:15px}
footer a{color:#e9e2d6}
.fgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:28px}
footer .logo{color:#fff}
.legal{border-top:1px solid #4a453f;margin-top:32px;padding-top:18px;font-size:13px;color:#b9b0a2}
.rev{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px);transition:.7s}.rev.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--sage);outline-offset:3px}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.rev{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}html{scroll-behavior:auto}}
@media (max-width:820px){
 .menu{display:block}
 nav{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:68px;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:none}
 nav.open{display:block}
 nav ul{flex-direction:column;gap:0;padding:8px 22px 16px}nav li a{display:block;padding:12px 0;font-size:17px}
 .hero,.two,.contact{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .hero{padding:36px 0 60px}.art{max-width:380px;margin:0 auto;width:100%}
 section{padding:64px 0}
 .gal{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
 .btn{flex:1 1 100%;text-align:center}
}
.art img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
figure{margin:0}
.wide{margin-top:48px;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.wide img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
figcaption{font-size:13px}
.wide figcaption,.shot figcaption{position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:12px;background:rgba(255,253,248,.88);color:#2a2724;padding:3px 12px;border-radius:99px;font-weight:500}
.gal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);grid-auto-rows:1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:36px}
.shot{position:relative;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:1;background:var(--bg2)}
.shot img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.shot.tall{grid-row:span 2;aspect-ratio:auto}
.feature{display:grid;grid-template-columns:260px 1fr;gap:36px;align-items:center;margin-top:36px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:24px}
.feature img{width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:12px;display:block}
.feature h3{font-size:34px;margin:8px 0 10px}
@media (max-width:820px){.gal{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.feature{grid-template-columns:1fr}.feature img{max-width:280px;margin:0 auto}}
.art{aspect-ratio:1/1.05;border-radius:28px}
.art img{object-position:center top}
footer{background:#2a2724;color:#e9e2d6}
footer .legal{color:#c9c0b2}
.btn.p{background:#4f6853;border-color:#4f6853;color:#fff}
.btn.p:hover{background:#2a2724;border-color:#2a2724;color:#fff}
.logo-panel{display:grid;place-items:center;padding:28px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);aspect-ratio:1/1.05}
.logo-panel svg{width:100%;max-width:400px;height:auto;opacity:1}
.serif{font-family:var(--serif)}
.lg-line{stroke:var(--ink)}.lg-line2{stroke:var(--taupe)}.lg-sage{stroke:var(--sage-d)}
.lg-fill{fill:var(--ink)}.lg-muted{fill:var(--muted)}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="demo">Demo privata a scopo dimostrativo · non è il sito ufficiale del salone · foto in attesa di autorizzazione del salone</div>
<header>
 <div class="wrap nav">
  <a class="logo" href="#top">Beauty And Fashion</a>
  <button class="menu" id="menu" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="nav">Menu</button>
  <nav id="nav" aria-label="Principale">
   <ul>
    <li><a href="#chi-siamo">Il salone</a></li>
    <li><a href="#servizi">Servizi</a></li>
    <li><a href="#filosofia">Filosofia</a></li>
    <li><a href="#galleria">Galleria</a></li>
    <li><a href="#contatti">Contatti</a></li>
   </ul>
  </nav>
 </div>
</header>

<main id="top">
<div class="wrap hero">
 <div>
  <span class="eyebrow">Parrucchiera · Varese</span>
  <h1>La bellezza dei tuoi capelli, valorizzata con cura</h1>
  <p>Un salone luminoso e rilassante dove ogni appuntamento è dedicato a una cliente alla volta, con attenzione alle tue esigenze e al risultato che desideri.</p>
  <div class="cta">
   <a class="btn p" id="book1" href="https://www.treatwell.it/salone/beauty-and-fashion/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Prenota un appuntamento</a>
   <a class="btn s" href="#servizi">Scopri i servizi</a>
  </div>
 </div>
 <div class="art logo-panel"><svg viewBox="0 0 400 440" role="img" aria-label="Logo Beauty And Fashion, parrucchiera a Varese: monogramma B&amp;F in un cerchio con un'onda color salvia"><title>Beauty And Fashion</title>
<circle class="lg-line" cx="200" cy="165" r="122" fill="none" stroke-width="1.6"/><circle class="lg-line2" cx="200" cy="165" r="113" fill="none" stroke-width="1"/>
<text class="lg-fill serif" x="200" y="198" text-anchor="middle" font-size="96" font-weight="600">B&amp;F</text>
<path class="lg-sage" d="M138 232c22 20 42 20 62 0s40-20 62 0" fill="none" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
<path class="lg-sage" d="M158 246c18 14 33 14 42 0s24-14 42 0" fill="none" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".6"/>
<text class="lg-fill serif" x="200" y="352" text-anchor="middle" font-size="42" font-weight="600">Beauty And Fashion</text>
<line class="lg-line2" x1="84" y1="388" x2="146" y2="388" stroke-width="1"/><line class="lg-line2" x1="254" y1="388" x2="316" y2="388" stroke-width="1"/>
<text class="lg-muted" x="200" y="393" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" letter-spacing="3.2" font-family="Inter,system-ui,sans-serif" font-weight="500">VARESE</text>
<text class="lg-muted" x="200" y="420" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" letter-spacing="3.2" font-family="Inter,system-ui,sans-serif" font-weight="500">PARRUCCHIERA</text></svg></div>
</div>

<section id="chi-siamo" class="alt">
 <div class="wrap two rev">
  <div>
   <span class="eyebrow">Il salone</span>
   <h2>Un ambiente accogliente, un tempo tutto per te</h2>
   <p class="lead">Beauty And Fashion è un salone ampio, luminoso e confortevole, pensato per concederti un momento di relax. Qui si lavora su appuntamento, così puoi contare su puntualità e su un'attenzione dedicata.</p>
   <p class="lead">Dietro le forbici c'è <strong>Debora Parrucci</strong>, che ama aiutare le clienti a sentirsi a proprio agio e a valorizzare il proprio viso attraverso l'acconciatura. Ascolto, consiglio e cura del dettaglio guidano ogni servizio. Per i trattamenti il salone utilizza prodotti Raywell.</p>
  </div>
  <ul class="pills">
   <li><b>Su appuntamento</b><span>Tempo e attenzione per ogni cliente</span></li>
   <li><b>Ascolto</b><span>Partiamo da ciò che desideri</span></li>
   <li><b>Puntualità</b><span>Rispetto del tuo tempo</span></li>
   <li><b>Relax</b><span>Un ambiente sereno e luminoso</span></li>
  </ul>
 </div>
 <div class="wrap rev"><figure class="wide"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," width="900" height="492" loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="Interno del salone: pareti color tortora, mensola con prodotti, casco asciugacapelli e un arco decorato"><figcaption>Gli spazi del salone</figcaption></figure></div>
</section>

<section id="servizi">
 <div class="wrap">
  <span class="eyebrow">Servizi</span>
  <h2>Servizi per i tuoi capelli</h2>
  <p class="lead">Dal taglio al colore, ogni servizio è pensato attorno a te.</p>
  <div class="grid" id="services"></div>
  <div class="feature rev"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," width="800" height="1066" loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="Locandina del salone: forbici con filo rosso a forma di cuore e la scritta Taglio curativo a caldo"><div><span class="eyebrow">In evidenza</span><h3>Taglio curativo a caldo</h3><p class="lead">Un taglio pensato per rinforzare e inspessire i capelli sottili e fragili. Chiedi consiglio alla tua parrucchiera di fiducia.</p><p class="note">Dettagli e prezzo del servizio da confermare con il salone.</p></div></div>
  <p class="note">Prezzi indicativi, da confermare al momento della prenotazione.</p>
 </div>
</section>

<section id="filosofia" class="alt">
 <div class="wrap rev">
  <span class="eyebrow">Filosofia</span>
  <h2>Cura, non fretta</h2>
  <div class="grid">
   <div class="card"><h3>Una cliente alla volta</h3><p class="lead">Durante il tuo appuntamento l'attenzione è tutta per te.</p></div>
   <div class="card"><h3>Esigenze individuali</h3><p class="lead">Ogni viso e ogni capello sono diversi: il consiglio nasce dall'ascolto.</p></div>
   <div class="card"><h3>Ambiente confortevole</h3><p class="lead">Spazi ampi e luminosi, per prenderti una pausa dalla giornata.</p></div>
   <div class="card"><h3>Risultato curato</h3><p class="lead">Consulenza personalizzata e attenzione al dettaglio, dall'inizio alla fine.</p></div>
  </div>
 </div>
</section>

<section id="galleria">
 <div class="wrap rev">
  <span class="eyebrow">Galleria</span>
  <h2>Tagli, pieghe e colori</h2>
  <p class="lead">Alcuni risultati di colore, piega e taglio.</p>
  <div class="gal"><figure class="shot"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="Onde morbide su capelli scuri con riflessi rossi"><figcaption>Onde e riflessi rossi</figcaption></figure><figure class="shot"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="Capelli lisci con toni rosa pastello su base chiara"><figcaption>Toni rosa pastello</figcaption></figure><figure class="shot"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="Caschetto con sfumature chiare visto da dietro"><figcaption>Caschetto chiaro</figcaption></figure><figure class="shot"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="Capelli lisci di media lunghezza con sfumature color rame, visti da dietro"><figcaption>Sfumature rame</figcaption></figure><figure class="shot"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="Onde morbide su capelli castani con riflessi caldi"><figcaption>Onde castane</figcaption></figure><figure class="shot"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="Ricci rossi e bordeaux lucenti"><figcaption>Rosso intenso</figcaption></figure></div>
 </div>
</section>

<section id="contatti" class="alt">
 <div class="wrap rev">
  <span class="eyebrow">Prenotazioni e contatti</span>
  <h2>Prenota il tuo appuntamento</h2>
  <div class="contact">
   <div class="card">
    <h3>Come raggiungerci</h3>
    <a class="tel" id="tel" href="tel:+393457124437">+39 345 712 4437</a>
    <p id="addr">Via Giulio Uberti 7<br>21100 Varese (VA)</p>
    <div class="cta">
     <a class="btn p" href="https://www.treatwell.it/salone/beauty-and-fashion/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Prenota su Treatwell</a>
     <a class="btn s" id="dir" href="https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=Via+Giulio+Uberti+7%2C+21100+Varese" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Indicazioni stradali</a>
    </div>
    <p id="social" class="note"></p>
   </div>
   <div class="card">
    <h3>Orari <span class="tbc">da confermare con il salone</span></h3>
    <table class="hours" id="hours"><tbody></tbody></table>
   </div>
  </div>
 </div>
</section>
</main>

<footer>
 <div class="wrap">
  <div class="fgrid">
   <div><a class="logo" href="#top">Beauty And Fashion</a><p>Salone di parrucchiera<br>Via Giulio Uberti 7, 21100 Varese</p></div>
   <div><p>Telefono: <a href="tel:+393457124437">+39 345 712 4437</a></p><p><a href="https://www.treatwell.it/salone/beauty-and-fashion/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Prenota su Treatwell</a></p></div>
   <div><p><a href="#servizi">Servizi</a><br><a href="#galleria">Galleria</a><br><a href="#contatti">Contatti</a></p></div>
  </div>
  <p class="legal"><!-- DATI LEGALI: inserire ragione sociale, P. IVA e informativa privacy dopo verifica con il salone -->[Dati legali da inserire dopo verifica con il salone] · Demo non ufficiale, realizzata a scopo dimostrativo.</p>
 </div>
</footer>

<script>
/* ===== DATI MODIFICABILI: prezzi, orari, telefono, social ===== */
var SERVICES=[
 {t:"Piega",d:"Da 30 a 55 minuti, in base alla lunghezza",r:[["Capelli corti","20 €"],["Capelli medi","26 €"],["Capelli lunghi","30 €"]]},
 {t:"Taglio e piega",d:"Circa un'ora",r:[["Capelli corti","35 €"],["Capelli medi","35 €"],["Capelli lunghi","45 €"],["Taglio con forbici a caldo e piega","50 €"]]},
 {t:"Colore",d:"Con piega inclusa",r:[["Radice senza ammoniaca, capelli medi","46 €"],["Radice senza ammoniaca, capelli lunghi","56 €"],["Radice, capelli corti","46 €"],["Ritocco colore, capelli lunghi","56 €"]]},
 {t:"Effetti luce",d:"",r:[["Effetti luce","da 77 €"]]},
 {t:"Trattamenti specifici",d:"",r:[["Trattamento forma","da 69 €"],["Trattamento specifico per capelli","95 €"]]}
];
var HOURS=[["Lunedì","09:00–18:30"],["Martedì","Chiuso"],["Mercoledì","09:00–18:30"],["Giovedì","09:00–18:30"],["Venerdì","09:00–18:30"],["Sabato","09:00–16:30"],["Domenica","Chiuso"]];
var SOCIAL=[]; /* es. [["Instagram","https://..."]] — aggiungere solo dopo verifica dei profili */

var h=function(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return{"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]})};
document.getElementById("services").innerHTML=SERVICES.map(function(s){
 return '<article class="card rev"><h3>'+h(s.t)+'</h3><p class="dur">'+h(s.d||"\u00a0")+'</p>'+
 s.r.map(function(x){return '<div class="row"><span>'+h(x[0])+'</span><b>'+h(x[1])+'</b></div>'}).join("")+'</article>'}).join("");
document.querySelector("#hours tbody").innerHTML=HOURS.map(function(x){return "<tr><td>"+h(x[0])+"</td><td>"+h(x[1])+"</td></tr>"}).join("");
if(SOCIAL.length)document.getElementById("social").innerHTML=SOCIAL.map(function(x){return '<a href="'+h(x[1])+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">'+h(x[0])+'</a>'}).join(" · ");

var m=document.getElementById("menu"),n=document.getElementById("nav");
m.addEventListener("click",function(){var o=n.classList.toggle("open");m.setAttribute("aria-expanded",o)});
n.addEventListener("click",function(e){if(e.target.tagName==="A"){n.classList.remove("open");m.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false")}});
var els=document.querySelectorAll(".rev");
if("IntersectionObserver" in window){var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add("in");io.unobserve(e.target)}})},{threshold:.1});els.forEach(function(e){io.observe(e)})}
else els.forEach(function(e){e.classList.add("in")});
</script>
</body>
</html>
